sentences.text: ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Vishal Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.S. Rathore, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 05/08/2025 1.
The jurisdiction of this Court has been invoked by way of filing an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. at the instance of accused-petitioner.

It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioner that no case for the alleged offences is made Balakaram vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:34386) on 5 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66809747/
1 out against him and his incarceration is not warranted.

There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of bail to the [2025:RJ-JD:34386] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-5958/2025]
accused-petitioner and he has been made an accused based on conjectures and surmises.

3. Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.
4. I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and gone through the niceties of the case, more particularly, statement of P.W.-5 (Gaju Devi), who happens to be mother of the deceased.
A perusal of the statement of the above witness making it abundantly clear that there was no condition for solemnizing of marriage in lieu of monetary consideration or handing over of valuables.
The husband and wife cohabited for ten years and she begotten two kids.
In her examination-in-chief itself, she had stated that there was a simple discord between the spouses and nothing special was told to her.
The lady went to her matrimonial home for around ten years and she committed suicide there.
Prima facie, there is no material to show or suggest that the deceased was subjected to cruelty for or in connection of demand of dowry soon before her death.
What was the immediate or instant cause which may have driven the lady to end her life, is not clear.
The petitioner is behind the bars since a long.
There is high probability that the trial may take long time to conclude.

In light of these facts and circumstances, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioner in the present matter.
[2025

5. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner as named in the cause title shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(FARJAND ALI),J 32-divya/-
